capture_type: Selected fields from saved native Splunk job JSON

content.search:
| makeresults count=4
| streamstats count as rownum
| eval EventCode=case(((rownum>=1 AND rownum<=2) OR rownum=4), 10, (rownum=3), 3),
    _time=case((rownum=1 OR (rownum>=3 AND rownum<=4)), 1735689660, (rownum=2), 1735689720),
    Computer="host-a",
    TargetImage="C:\\Windows\\System32\\lsass.exe",
    TargetProcessId=500,
    SourceImage="C:\\Tools\\diagnostic.exe",
    SourceProcessId=100,
    CallTrace=case((rownum=1 OR rownum=3), "C:\\Windows\\System32\\dbghelp.dll+0x10", (rownum=2), "C:\\Windows\\System32\\dbgcore.dll+0x20", (rownum=4), "C:\\Windows\\System32\\kernel32.dll+0x10")
| fields EventCode _time Computer TargetImage TargetProcessId SourceImage SourceProcessId CallTrace
| search EventCode=10 TargetImage=*lsass.exe CallTrace=*dbgcore.dll* OR CallTrace=*dbghelp.dll*
| stats count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime by Computer, TargetImage, TargetProcessId, SourceImage, SourceProcessId
| rename Computer as dest
